title: AriensCo Museum

services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Open TUESDAYS through Thursdays from 12 pm to 4 pm - guided museum tours available on Thursdays. Our school programs combine the exploration of our 14,000 sq. ft. Museum with a scavenger hunt and a STEM-based workshop in a classroom setting. Your students will journey through 130 years of innovations and straight into designing their own products for the future. We offer students of all ages a variety of STEM workshops that focus on either the Engineering and Design Process with LEGO Robotics or Coding challenges with codable robots. Our STEM challenges are tailored to fit your group’s needs and ability levels by our staff Educator with 30 years of classroom experience. AriensCo Museum
